objective: Fetch a sample PDF from an external source, ingest it into Docling RAG, search it, generate a report, and run an approval loop (accept/reject/cancel).

nodes.description: Download the sample PDF from the external document source

config.node_objective: Download http://sample-docs:8080/sample.pdf to /workspace/fetch-sample-doc/sample.pdf and verify it is a valid PDF (starts with %PDF).

nodes.description: Upload the PDF to Docling RAG and wait until indexed

config.node_objective: Upload /workspace/fetch-sample-doc/sample.pdf to http://docling-rag:8080/api/upload (multipart field 'file'). Verify the ingestion receipt contains a document_id, then poll GET /api/documents until status is indexed. Write /workspace/upload-to-rag/receipt.json.

nodes.description: Search the indexed PDF for key facts

config.node_objective: POST http://docling-rag:8080/api/search with {'query': 'what does the sample document say about document processing?', 'mode': 'hybrid', 'k': 5} and header 'X-Api-Key: docling-rag'. Save the results to /workspace/search-rag/results.json. Only report facts present in the returned snippets.

nodes.description: Build a report from the RAG search results

config.node_objective: Read /workspace/search-rag/results.json and write /workspace/generate-report/report.md summarising what the document says about intelligent document processing, citing the retrieved snippets.

nodes.description: User approves, rejects (rework loop), or cancels the RAG report

config.question: Approve the RAG report? (reject will rework and re-ask)

config.node_objective: Read the previous report inputs and write /workspace/rework-report/REWORKED.md with a revised RAG-based report.
Write /workspace/finalize-report/FINAL.md stating the RAG report is accepted and final.
